instructions.tail: Codex CLI: once its hooks are trusted in `/hooks`, the startup brief and checkpoint reminder arrive by hook; otherwise run `vaultctl.py session-brief` once. Checkpoint on this session's rollout in `~/.codex/sessions/`, model from its `turn_context.model`.

notes: User skills are $HOME/.agents/skills per developers.openai.com/codex/skills (checked 2026-10-18); earlier releases installed ~/.codex/skills, which is refreshed in place when present and never created. Hooks per developers.openai.com/codex/hooks (checked 2026-10-18): ~/.codex/hooks.json, enabled by default ([features].hooks), each new hook needs trust in /hooks; SessionStart plain stdout becomes developer context, PostToolUse apply_patch carries the patch in tool_input.command, Stop needs JSON {decision: block} on exit 0 and turns the reason into a continuation prompt; the payload carries model.
